findingsSummary: Many attestation/death/accession claims carry westernYear/Interval labeled “outside-knowledge conversion” while the Chinese evidence supplies only regnal dates (e.g. 正始八年, 青龍二年, 咸寧四年).
Idiomatic English often already prints Western years (e.g. s0052 “She died in 247”); literal usually keeps the regnal form.

Pinned local reigns.json in this checkout does not yet contain Wei Zhengshi/Qinglong or Jin Taishi/Xianning mappings, so chapter-local calendar witnesses are insufficient to certify those conversions here.
Author must not invent seals or approve dates. Independent date audit (and any date-repair proposal staging) remains required.
recommendedIndependentActions: Run people:dates packet/audit against current source+extraction fingerprints with an independent reviewer conversation.

For claims whose only Western year is outside-knowledge conversion without a verified calendar witness, prefer unresolved+unresolvedReason retaining sourceDate, or attach a sealed chronology witness—do not silently keep invented precision.
